title: Kit 4 Top Cropped Sem Bojo para Academia Feminino Microfibra Alça Larga Cós Largo Preto Branco Azul Marinho Rosa
description:
Kit 4 Top Cropped Sem Bojo para Academia Feminino: 4 cores por R$ 51,90, ou seja, R$ 12,98 por peça.

Top cropped feminino sem bojo para academia, treino fitness e dia a dia. Microfibra macia, alça larga e cós largo.

O QUE VEM NO KIT
- 4 tops cropped femininos sem bojo
- Cores: preto, branco, azul-marinho e rosa

POR QUE VALE A PENA
- Microfibra macia que acompanha o movimento do treino
- Sem bojo: leve e sem enchimento
- Alça larga para mais conforto nos ombros
- Cós largo cropped com acabamento firme e confortável
- 4 cores para trocar no treino da semana sem repetir peça

PARA QUEM É
- Treino de academia e aulas fitness
- Dia a dia com calça, short ou saia
- Quem busca top feminino confortável e prático

MATERIAL E CUIDADOS
- Material: microfibra
- Lave do avesso, em ciclo suave, e seque à sombra para manter a cor
- Não use alvejante

Monte seu look de treino com as 4 cores por R$ 51,90 e pague R$ 12,98 por peça.
coverBrief: Square 1:1 use-case cover generated with GenerateImage, using the attached product photo as the reference image (image-to-image edit). Scene: a bright modern gym with large windows, wooden floor and plants, four fit women in real movement (a squat, arms stretched overhead, walking with a water bottle, a step on a treadmill), not a catalog pose. Each woman wears one of the four cropped tops from the reference, one color each, left to right: black, white, navy blue and hot pink. The brief asks for the reference cut (scoop neckline, wide straps, wide smooth band, cropped length, matte microfibra, no padding); this was checked by eye only, not measured. Bottoms changed to gym leggings and dark shorts; no text, price or KIT 4 label added. Saved to runs/campaigns/kit-4-top-cropped-sem-bojo-mvk6j/r1/covers/v02.png.
hypothesis: A use-case cover (capa uso) in a gym scene should lift CTR and affiliate short-video conversion for the academia angle compared with a catalog cover.

benchmark.pricePosition: R$ 51.90 for 4 pieces (R$ 12.98 per piece) vs median R$ 45.60 across 20 competitors (+14%); cheaper than 25% of them. Intel has no per-piece price, so the comparison is on the kit price.
differentiators: R$ 12.98 per piece for 4 pieces; the 4-piece 'sem bojo' kits 22099070066 and 58218753657 are at R$ 49.60 and R$ 56.88, and 22994447429 at R$ 57.44.
Wide straps (alça larga) and wide band (cós largo) in the same kit; 57118862429 and 22994447429 sell thin straps (alça fina / alça fina blogueira), so the cut is a clear contrast.
Four colors (black, white, navy, pink) in one kit; the competitor titles in the set do not list a color set.
